representative_novelties.title: Trust and reliance on AI — An experimental study on the extent and costs of overreliance on AI
representative_novelties.novelty_highlight: 通过领域无关的激励性交互实验证明，仅告知建议由AI生成就会导致用户过度依赖，且这种过度依赖不仅损害自身效率，还会对第三方产生负面影响。

representative_novelties.title: Cognitive ease at a cost: LLMs reduce mental effort but compromise depth in student scientific inquiry
representative_novelties.novelty_highlight: Randomized experiment comparing LLM versus traditional search engine use in scientific inquiry, showing that LLMs reduce cognitive load but also lower reasoning and argumentation quality.

representative_novelties.title: A systematic review of digital transformation technologies in museum exhibition
representative_novelties.novelty_highlight: First systematic review explicitly linking digital transformation technologies to specific museum exhibition application scenarios, addressing the underexplored technology-application gap and providing integrated insights for practitioners and scholars.

representative_novelties.title: The job demands-resources model as a theoretical lens for the bright and dark side of digitization
representative_novelties.novelty_highlight: Extends the Job Demands-Resources model to incorporate digital job demands and resources, empirically classifying the bright and dark sides of digitization using a large white-collar employee sample.

representative_novelties.title: Evaluating privacy, security, and trust perceptions in conversational AI: A systematic review
representative_novelties.novelty_highlight: 首次系统梳理CAI中隐私、安全与信任感知的子构念重叠关系，并指出三者联合研究的稀缺性，为开发可靠量表提供方向
